title: [Main][all-e]Prepayment Invoice and Quantity Change Issue in Business Central
summary: Fixes an issue with prepayment invoices when the quantity is changed on purchase or sales lines. Purchase Line and Sales Line tables were updated in many localization layers, and tests were added.
key_points: Fixes prepayment invoice handling when line quantities change
Purchase Line updated in APAC, BE, CH, DACH, ES, FI, GB, IT, NA, NL, NO, RU, SE and W1
Sales Line updated in the same layers except DACH and NL
Prepayment tests added in the W1 and RU layers
